scripts.dev: npm run setup --silent && concurrently --names web,runner --prefix-colors green,yellow "next dev -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3030" "tsx watch --clear-screen=false src/runner/index.ts"
scripts.setup: (docker network inspect grove >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create grove >/dev/null) && docker compose up -d --wait && tsx scripts/migrate.ts
scripts.start: npm run setup --silent && concurrently --kill-others --names web,runner --prefix-colors green,yellow "next start -H 127.0.0.1 -p 3030" "tsx src/runner/index.ts"
